test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete

the letter series.

I _ _ I _ I _ _ I _ J _

options.text: I J I I J J I
J I I I J J I
J I J I J I I
I I J J J I J

solution:
Given series: I _ _ I _ I _ _ I _ J _

Option 1) I J I I J J I → I __I__ **__J/__** I __I__ I/ __I__ __J__ I/__J__ J __I__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) J I I I J J I → I __J__ __I/__ I __I__ I/ __I__ __J__ I/__J__ J __I__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) J I J I J I I → I __**J**__ __**I/**__ I __**J**__ I/ __**I**__ __**J**__ I/ __**I**__ J __**I**__ → (It follows the pattern of: IJI - IJI - IJI - IJI)

Option 4) I I J J J I J → I __I__ __I/__ I __J__ I/ __J__ __J__ I/ __I__ J __J__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
